views.name: store_total_orders
views.body_sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders FROM orders GROUP BY store_id
views.description: total number of orders per store

views.name: store_delivered_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'DELIVERED'
GROUP BY store_id
views.description: number of orders per store with a delivered delivery status
